column1: # Classic ESP32 4MB (RoArm). The 3MB ota_0 slot matches huge_app.csv so the
# arm image still fits. `littlefs` is a data partition beside it
# the old spiffs region (the arm firmware does not use that filesystem).
# Uploading the app does not erase `littlefs`. There is no second app slot:
# the 4MB flash has no room for dual OTA and a 3MB image.
